system: Covenant Broken Game Master Proposals and Entropy Engine
doctrine: In the shattered ruins of the Broken Covenant, stochastic disasters reflect ideological warfare, mechanical rot, and unexploded munitions of the robot war.

disaster_pool.name: Feral Combat Drone Swarm Incursion
disaster_pool.description: A deactivated warmachine battery awakens unexpectedly in the Glass Crags, releasing autonomous hunter-seeker drones programmed to exterminate any unindexed biological life.

consequences.sector_peril: Blocks safe passage through quadrant (2,1) until deactivated or repelled

disaster_pool.name: Rogue Logic Storm Resonance
disaster_pool.description: Corrupted machine network telemetry bleeds over high-frequency wireless channels from the Resonant Void, overloading neural ports and cognitive cybernetics.

consequences.sector_peril: Forces emergency dampening or disconnection of all cybernetic equipment

disaster_pool.name: Atmospheric Ionizing EMP Squall
disaster_pool.description: A collapsing sub-orbital orbital capacitor discharges into the upper stratosphere, showering the ruins in an electrostatic pulse storm.

consequences.sector_peril: Shuts down energy shields and battery heaters in non-lead-lined shelters

disaster_pool.name: Toxic Silicon Fallout & Nanite Cloud
disaster_pool.description: Thermal geysers near the Chimera Foundry pulverize irradiated silicon dust and decomposing bio-nanites, blanketing the wasteland in corrosive smog.

consequences.sector_peril: Requires sealed filtration rebreathers or lead-lined garments to traverse

disaster_pool.name: Ashen Purifier Inquisition Sweep
disaster_pool.description: Militant zealots of the Ashen Genesis deploy flamer squads to purge 'tainted' tech and biological augmentations from unaligned refugee enclaves.

consequences.gear_confiscation_threat: Destruction of unprotected cybernetics and diagnostic pads
consequences.human_casualty_risk: Severe burn injuries and refugee displacement
consequences.sector_peril: High tension and barricaded borders around the Ashen Cradle

disaster_pool.name: Iron Consensus Reclamation Sweep Squad
disaster_pool.description: Subjugated cyber-legionaries advance from the Consensus Spire under algorithmic directives to forcefully neural-tether wandering scavengers.

consequences.autonomy_peril: Forced implementation of behavioral obedience chips
consequences.sector_peril: Scanners deploy bio-ident tracking drones across trade avenues

improvisation_templates.name: Brokering Neutral Scavenger Truce
improvisation_templates.context: When opposing faction patrols clash in Scrap Hollow
improvisation_templates.resolution_test: Requires Elias to balance clarity and agency against polarized demands
improvisation_templates.outcome_neutral: Preserves Scrap Hollow as a functioning safe zone at personal diplomatic cost

improvisation_templates.name: Ad-Hoc Containment Patch on Core Leak
improvisation_templates.context: When an antimatter or EMP fissure threatens collapse
improvisation_templates.resolution_test: Manual repairs under extreme radiation and cognitive noise
improvisation_templates.outcome_neutral: Averts catastrophic detonation while incurring severe neural strain
